name: Sofia Herrera
bio:
Sofia Herrera's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly, fueled by a chance encounter with a local racing team while studying engineering at the National Autonomous University of Mexico. Intrigued, she volunteered her skills, quickly becoming an indispensable part of the team's operations. Her meticulous approach and sharp technical mind led to significant performance improvements, earning her recognition and a scholarship to a motorsport engineering program in Europe. 

Returning to Mexico, Sofia climbed the ranks of various racing teams, consistently demonstrating her ability to optimize performance and foster a collaborative environment. Her leadership style emphasizes data-driven decision-making and empowering her team members to take ownership. As team principal for Prema Racing, Sofia brings a unique blend of technical expertise, strategic thinking, and a relentless drive to achieve victory, making her a formidable force in the paddock. She is known for her keen eye for talent and her commitment to developing the next generation of racing professionals.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, slightly wavy, often pulled back in a low ponytail
physical.description: Sofia is a woman of medium height with a strong, determined presence.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with technical diagrams and calculations.
Has a habit of tapping her pen against her teeth when deep in thought.
Prefers to conduct team briefings standing up, believing it promotes energy and engagement.
